induction l generalizing acc with
| nil => simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
| cons a l ih =>
  simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
  congr 1
  funext x
  cases x <;> simp [ih (acc := acc), ih (acc := [_]), Functor.map_map]
induction l generalizing acc <;> simp [List.filterMapM.loop] <;> grind
